{{Quote|Wish I'd seen that sight a thousand times before.|The rescue worker, to the ''Taris Holofeed''|<ref name="HolofeedSiege">{{KOTORbackups|15}}</ref>}}
A '''rescue worker''' was a witness to an incident during the [[Taris Siege]]<ref name="HolofeedSiege" /> in [[3963 BBY]]<ref name="KotOR15">[[Knights of the Old Republic 15|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 15]]</ref> in which a [[Unidentified Tarisian surveillance droid|city surveillance droid]] attempted to issue a parking citation to a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] bomb, causing it to go off without injuring anyone. Afterward, the rescuer was interviewed by the ''[[Taris Holofeed]]'', and although the worker gave them a quote to use in publication, the rescuer asked to remain anonymous.<ref name="HolofeedSiege" />

==Behind the scenes==
The rescue worker appears in the [[in-universe]] news organ ''[[The Taris Holofeed: Siege Edition]]'',<ref name="HolofeedSiege" /> which was written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and included in [[Knights of the Old Republic 15|the fifteenth issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Knights of the Old Republic'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series.<ref name="KotOR15" />
